errors.what: Wheel angle panel is discontinuous and does not show a proper 90 deg index per revolution for n=4. It starts decreasing from 135 (132.4 at t=5.50), then jumps up to 180 at t=0.00 (expected about 90 at mid-engagement), then falls to 135 by t=1.00. Net wheel advance over one engagement is about 0 in the panel (135 to 135), not -90 deg (clockwise, opposite to the driver). The panel numbers disagree with the motion shown.
